currency: USD millions (except per-share and price data)
sources: LULU Form 10-K for fiscal 2025 (year ended 2026-02-01), filed ~March 2026
Market data aggregators (stockanalysis.com, GuruFocus, stock-analysis-on.net) as of ~Sept 2026
notes: Revenue, EBIT, net income, EPS, and all balance-sheet figures are directly sourced and cross-checked (total assets - total equity = total liabilities reconciles exactly). D&A is directly sourced for FY2023-FY2024 (10-K Note 5); FY2025 D&A is extrapolated. Full-year capex and CFO are NOT separately disclosed in the sources pulled here, so they are modeled as CFO = Net Income + D&A (ignoring working capital changes) and capex is estimated from disclosed quarterly run-rates and MD&A commentary. This is flagged so it isn't mistaken for a directly-sourced figure -- swap in the real 10-K cash flow statement lines if you want full precision.

dcf_assumptions.note: Guidance-reset thesis: LULU cut FY2026 revenue guidance materially (from +2-4% to -5% to -7%) between its FY2025 year-end report and later FY2026 quarters, and the stock is down roughly 49% from its all-time high. This models a near-term revenue/FCF contraction before stabilizing, rather than reusing a generic growth assumption -- swap in your own view of the turnaround timeline.
